text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Inari, Inari! You gotta hear this! I did
something
amazing today!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what's the hubbub? Take a
breath.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I can't help it. Today, I ate lunch
together with
Teio!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Get this—I had one more bowl of rice
than she
did! Amazing, right?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow, big props to you! That's some real
spirit ya
got there, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Really? You think I did good?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah—ya gotta eat well to run well,
that's for
sure. And you can eat with the
best of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... eheheh! Hehehe! Go on, Inari,
say even
more cool stuff about me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, look at the smirk on your mug.
Y'know I
can't refuse a face like that.
